description: Semantic role map for TREC 36-11 (HOA Addendum). MODE-A-ONLY MAP built 2026-09-08 (Carter): contains ONLY the party signing widgets (signatures + footer initials) — deal/property fields are not mapped here (the fill engine handles them via its own field maps). Coordinates extracted from the live AcroForm widget rects (pdf-lib, same method as the 2026-09-02 role-map batch); party assignment derived by rendering the page and reading the printed labels, NOT from AcroForm field names. x_pct/y_pct/w_pct/h_pct are top-left-origin percentages 0-100.
